pages.text: At first glance the satchel appears to be a normal bag, of moderate size and storage capacity. However, closer inspection reveals that a $(#AA00AA)Foliot$() is bound to the satchel, tasked with assisting the summoner in drawing pentacles for their rituals.$()

pages.title: About
pages.text: A ritual satchel can hold items needed to create pentacles for rituals.$(br)An item with durability will be used until only 1 durability remains, which will stop the glint effect.$(br)Other items cannot be placed in the satchel.$()

pages.title: About
pages.text: $(br2)The satchel allows to speed up setting pentacles by automatically choosing the right items from the satchel, instead of manually selecting chalks, candles and other items to place them.$(br)

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: 1. $(#55FF55)Shift-Right-Click$() to open the satchel and place chalks, candles, crystals, skulls and other items needed for rituals.$(br)2. Using this book, use the "eye" icon to preview the pentacle you want to set up in the world.$(br)3. $(#55FF55)Right-Click$() $()

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: with this book to anchor the preview pentacle in the spot where you want to set it up.$(br)4. $(#55FF55)Right-Click$() with the satchel on a previewed chalk mark or block to automatically place it.$(br)5. Repeat until the pentacle is complete.$()

pages.title: Chalk Brush
pages.text: The ritual satchel can also store your $(item)Chalk Brush$().$(br)The stored brush will be selected and used automatically when you $(#55FF55)Right-Click$() on chalk glyphs.$(br)
